mapper.insert: insert into user_raffle_order(user_id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, order_state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{strategyId}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{orderState})
mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, order_state from user_raffle_order where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and order_state = 'create'
